core_meaning.primary_meaning: Isam is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Protector, safeguard, guardian”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Isam corresponds to the Arabic form عصام (Arabic root ع ص م (ʿ-ṣ-m); عِصَام (ʿIṣām)). Its core sense is protector, safeguard, guardian. Isam is Arabic عِصَام (ʿIṣām) 'protector, safeguard, guardian', from the root ع ص م (ʿ-ṣ-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source repeated the Latin string in the Arabic column and glossed the name 'Given by God'; the correct form is عِصَام. Same name as isaam and issam.
